_comment: How scripts/generate-examples.mjs builds this example from the skill's assets/. host = 'clean' because Approach A is C# registered into DI plus a backoffice manifest; it needs no content of its own. namespace = what <Namespace> becomes. placeholders = <IssuerName>, the label shown in the authenticator app. assets = Approach A's files only (the member approach is the blank host's example). The manifest is embedded and written to the host's App_Plugins by ExampleHostWiring.cs.
